'''Donald Luther Birx''' is an American physicist and academic administrator who has been the 15th president of [[Plymouth State University]] since 2015. Prior to assuming office on July 31, 2015, Birx was an administrator at [[Pennsylvania State University]], the [[University of Houston System]], and the [[New Mexico State University]].

== Early life and education ==
Birx was born in [[Pennsylvania]], the son of Donald Birx Sr., a mathematician and electrical engineer, and Adele Birx (née Sparks), a nursing instructor. His younger sister, [[Deborah Birx]], is a physician and diplomat. His brother, Daniel "Danny" Birx, died in a plane crash in 2000.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Rushing|first=Claudia Vargas, Ellie|date=30 March 2020|title=From Pa. science fairs to coronavirus response coordinator: Deborah Birx's path to the White House|url=https://www.inquirer.com/news/nation-world/deborah-birx-white-house-coronavirus-task-force-trump-carlisle-20200330.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200331215059/https://www.inquirer.com/news/nation-world/deborah-birx-white-house-coronavirus-task-force-trump-carlisle-20200330.html |archive-date=2020-03-31 |access-date=2020-12-23|language=en-US}}</ref> Birx earned a Bachelor of Science degree in engineering physics from the [[University of California, Berkeley]], a Master of Science in physics and [[Master of Business Administration]] from [[Miami University]], and a PhD in electrical engineering and artificial intelligence from the [[University of Dayton]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Office of President – Plymouth State University|url=https://campus.plymouth.edu/president/|access-date=2020-12-23|language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Remarks at Swearing-in Ceremony for Ambassador-at-Large and Coordinator of the USG Activities to Combat HIV/AIDS Deborah Birx|url=https://2009-2017.state.gov/secretary/remarks/2014/04/225218.htm|access-date=2020-12-23|website=U.S. Department of State}}</ref>

== Career ==
Birx began his career at Systems Research Laboratories, Inc., where he was a senior research scientist, principal investigator, and general manager of the intelligent systems division. He then relocated to [[Las Cruces, New Mexico]], where he became a professor of physics and interim vice president for research at [[New Mexico State University]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Donald Birx Named Vice Chancellor|url=https://www.uh.edu/nsm/news-events/stories/2006/0817_birx|access-date=2020-12-23|website=www.uh.edu|language=en}}</ref> Birx later worked as the vice chancellor and vice president for research of [[University of Houston System]]. Prior to his tenure at [[Plymouth State University]], Birx was the chancellor of [[Penn State Erie, The Behrend College]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Birx begins tenure as Penn State Behrend chancellor {{!}} Penn State University|url=https://news.psu.edu/story/166355/2010/07/01/birx-begins-tenure-penn-state-behrend-chancellor|access-date=2020-12-23|website=news.psu.edu|language=en}}</ref>

In May 2015 trustees of the [[University System of New Hampshire]] announced that Birx had been selected to serve as the 15th president of [[Plymouth State University]], succeeding Sara Jayne Steen. He assumed office on July 31, 2015.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Donald Birx named next President of Plymouth State University|url=http://www.nhfrontpage.com/Articles-Plymouth-Record-Enterprise-c-2015-05-20-160364.113119-Donald-Birx-named-next-President-of-Plymouth-State-University.html|access-date=2020-12-23|website=www.nhfrontpage.com}}</ref>

In October 2025, after the departure of Keene State President Melinda Treadwell, the University System of New Hampshire Board of Trustees appointed Birx as interim president of [[Keene State College]]. Birx is serving concurrently as president of both institutions through June 30, 2026. During this period, day-to-day operations at Keene State are overseen by Provost Kirsti Sandy and Executive Vice President for Finance and Administration Nathalie Houder.<ref>{{Cite web |date=October 17, 2025 |title=Plymouth State University's Birx Tapped to Lead Keene State in Interim Joint-Presidency Role |url=https://www.keene.edu/news/2025/10/plymouth-state-universitys-birx-tapped-lead-keene-state-interim-joint-presidency-role |access-date=January 10, 2025 |website=keene.edu}}</ref>
